answer: Honest work runs 34 minutes a proof; the farm needs 440 proofs, which is 14960 minutes it cannot paint. Printers and agents look alike until Dollmaker toy cart mark counted beside the toy fair calls for each toy cart is a count of whittled joints checked beside the paint mark; after that, only agents reply. One ridge proves a maker, one dawn proves a payment, one jade proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age.
